name: Why do I smell sewer gas in my house?

mainEntity.name: Why do I smell sewer gas in my house?

acceptedAnswer.text: Sewer gas odors typically indicate a problem with your home's plumbing system. Common causes include a dry P-trap under sinks or showers, a cracked sewer pipe, a blocked or damaged vent pipe on the roof, or a compromised wax ring seal at the base of a toilet. Sometimes, it can also be due to an unused drain that has allowed the water in the P-trap to evaporate, letting sewer gases escape into your home.
acceptedAnswer.description: Sewer gas odors often result from dry P-traps, damaged pipes, or vent issues in your plumbing system.
